_readme: 궁합 리포트 카피. overview_by_grade/daystem_point_by_relation은 등급(A/B/C/D)·일간관계(sangsaeng/sanggeuk/same)별로 다른 문구가 나가도록 compatibility_engine.js의 renderReport()가 조회하는 구조입니다. liuhe_bonus는 일지 육합이 있을 때만 추가로 붙습니다. en/ko 텍스트만 교체하면 코드 수정 없이 바로 반영됩니다. {{score}}/{{grade}}는 코드에서 자동으로 채워지는 값이니 그대로 두세요.

A.en: A strong match — your Day Masters support each other's growth, and the energy between you flows easily. The work here isn't compatibility, it's not taking it for granted.

B.en: A solid match with real chemistry, but not effortless — you complement each other in some areas and pull in different directions in others. Worth building on.

C.en: A mixed match — there's genuine attraction, but the elemental balance creates friction points you'll both need to name and work through deliberately.

D.en: A challenging match on paper — your charts clash more than they align. This doesn't mean the relationship can't work, but it will take more conscious effort than most.

sangsaeng.en: One of you naturally feeds the other's energy — like wood feeding fire. This usually shows up as one partner instinctively supporting or inspiring the other's growth.

sanggeuk.en: One of you naturally checks the other's energy — like wood breaking through earth. This creates real tension, but controlled tension can also produce growth neither of you would reach alone.

same.en: You share the same core element. That means you understand each other quickly, but you may also mirror each other's blind spots rather than balancing them out.

liuhe_bonus.en: Your Day Branches form a Six Harmony — a classical sign of easy, comfortable chemistry that tends to show up immediately rather than growing slowly.

lover.en: Use this reading as a conversation starter, not a verdict. Whatever friction points show up above, name them directly with your partner rather than assuming they'll resolve on their own.

friend.en: Use this reading as a conversation starter, not a verdict. Whatever friction points show up above, name them directly with your partner rather than assuming they'll resolve on their own.

business.en: Use this reading as a conversation starter, not a verdict. Whatever friction points show up above, name them directly with your partner rather than assuming they'll resolve on their own.

disclaimer.en: This analysis is for entertainment purposes only and should not replace professional relationship counseling.
disclaimer.ko: 본 분석은 오락 목적으로 제공되며, 전문 상담을 대체하지 않습니다.
